name: remesso-x402
description: Pay Remesso's paid HTTP services on Celo mainnet over x402 v2 — in USA₮ by default (USDC and USD₮ also accepted), gasless for the payer. Use it to buy live NGN rates or to bring a scheduled stablecoin payment forward.

payment.gas: paid by the facilitator — the payer needs the token, not CELO
payment.authoritative: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of an unpaid request — this file is a snapshot of it

services.name: naira-rate
services.description: Live USDT/NGN and USDC/NGN from on-chain RFQ makers: bid, ask and last, with mid and spread when both sides are quoted and null for both when they are not. What Remesso prices a naira corridor from.

services.name: latam-rate
services.description: Live USD-to-wARS and USD-to-wBRL on Celo from two independent on-chain sources side by side — Textile's RFQ makers and the Uniswap pool at your size — with a flag when they disagree. wCOP has no on-chain market on Celo and is reported as such, never priced from elsewhere.

input.usd: optional trade size to price the pool at (default 100, max 100000)

services.name: latam-route
services.description: How to deliver an amount of pesos or reais on Celo: the token, the dollars it takes at your size and from which venue (with price impact), Ripio's public buy and cash-out links and a prefilled Remesso schedule link. Moves nothing and signs nothing. Argentina and Brazil are priced on-chain; Colombia gets the Ripio route only.

input.amount: number, in local currency unless currency is USD

services.name: trigger-run
services.description: Bring one payment of an existing schedule forward. The caller buys timing and nothing else. Stablecoin payouts only: naira schedules are refused before a price is quoted.

input.schedule: on-chain schedule id, as a decimal string
